notes.content:
・O stage was changed to a new stage.
・Fixed objects (cars, bullets, etc.) to stand still when the settings screen is displayed.
・Improved the movement of the player getting caught on the edge of the floor.
・Fixed a problem where the player was caught in the stage selection screen.

notes.title: Update Ver 1.2 (September 23, 2024)
notes.content:
・Tutorial:
　　- Added explanation of how to unlock the wire in tutorial (1/5)
　　- Fixed Tutorial (3/5) to ensure it cannot be completed until Tutorial (2/5) is finished.
　　- Fixed Tutorial (4/5) to display hints after a certain amount of time.
・E stage (increased difficulty):
　　- Added one blue block before the target point.
・N stage:
　　- Fixed N-shaped frames to be blue blocks.
・P stage (increased difficulty): 
　　- All checkpoints can be passed by going back and forth between rooms with white blocks, modified to change to black blocks when landing in a room again after exiting a room.
　　- Added sound.
・V stage (difficulty down):
　　- Fixed the stage description. 
　　- Fixed the wire to cut automatically after the first throw hits the pin.
　　- Fixed to increase pin action.
　　- Added sound when pins are hit.
・Z stage: Minor adjustments.
・Fixed rounded corners on icons.
・Fixed the stage description in the English version.
